meta.description: Matches physical cable faults with appropriate testing tools.

question.text: A technician needs to identify a miswired copper cable and locate a break in a cable run. Select two suitable tools or tool functions.
options: Cable tester that checks wire map and continuity
Time-domain reflectometer (TDR) for locating cable faults
Packet capture software to measure cable pinout directly
DNS lookup utility to detect copper shorts
correctAnswers: Cable tester that checks wire map and continuity
Time-domain reflectometer (TDR) for locating cable faults
